move_rolled_with_modifier.text:
Attacking the goblin in melee triggers Hack and Slash.

Rolled 4 + 5 + 1 = 10: 10+.

move.name: Hack and Slash
move.trigger: When you attack an enemy in melee

outcomes.strong_hit: On a 10+ you deal your damage.
outcomes.weak_hit: On a 7-9 you deal your damage and the enemy attacks you.

outcome.text: On a 10+ you deal your damage.

move_rolled_without_modifier.text:
Leaping the chasm under fire triggers Defy Danger.

Rolled 3 + 5 = 8. Add your modifier: -3 to -2: 6-; -1 to +1: 7-9; +2 to +3: 10+.

move.name: Defy Danger
move.trigger: When you act despite an imminent threat

outcomes.strong_hit: On a 10+, you do what you set out to.
outcomes.weak_hit: On a 7-9, you stumble or hesitate.
